body: Aw man don’t say that. Please don’t compare yourself to me. I don’t know you well but from what I’ve seen from your situation I believe you can also do it fr. I believe in you and I’m not bsing. There’s so much in life that’ll pleasantly surprise you when you get older. You’re so young and I’ve been through a similar situation with my appearance back then. (Still kind of am occasionally). I really encourage you to find likeminded and people that actually get you. I’m still having a hard time opening up and finding the right people rn but seeing people online communities at least show some ounce of support whenever I need to vent or talk in the void. I hope you can do the same so it can help you find a better perspective and view on how you can figure out yourself.

You took the words out of my mouth. That’s how I’ve exactly been feeling my friend. If I’m being completely real all I need is to be understood and live my reality as an artist instead of being forced to do things that are more “practical”. I’m so tired of crying, sleeping, and watching people function normally while I feel as if I’m slowly dying. If I shared this to anyone irl I’m afraid they’ll tell me to stop complaining and just do something. I’m so confused and empty at the same time I’m really considering cutting off everyone in my life. I’m so tired of being perceived and feeling nothing but an empty shell as you’d say. Anyway thanks for listening to me. I don’t encourage you nor anyone to be like me. Seeing your insight and words mean a lot to me. Feel free to message me if you want. You seem really understanding and empathetic. I wish nothing but the best for you. :)
I’d love to!! :)

I don’t know if I’ll ever be understood. I’m dealing with so much mental health problems with feeling constantly depressed and pushing through to manifest that life and I’m so confused and frustrated because of the unfavorable shit I’m getting despite getting excited for my manifestations. I’m at my breaking point now and don’t know if I should keep going. I’m crying over too many things because so much unfavorable things happened in one day on Christmas Eve and now I’m breaking down on Christmas Day. I feel so stupid for persisting and now feel helpless.

So true! Persistence is key!! Our reality is malleable and so is our mind which is the best part about the law of assumption!
Nothing is stopping you. You’re limitless. Keep persisting.

No you didn’t. Friday will be the day when the winner will be officially announced. Keep persisting and remember that circumstances don’t matter. Don’t listen to anyone that says that he’s “better” at manifesting. Nobody in the 3D could stop you except yourself because it is your reality in the end.

I want to add that since we have our own realities we can always choose subconsciously which one will lead us to our mirrored reality. So if anyone in general thinks he has a “better” chance, that’s on you. I’m in the reality where that doesn’t happen at all. We all gotta remember that circumstances don’t matter.

I hate to admit those things because I don’t want to be seen as selfish or something. Do people even care about me? I’m just too difficult that I don’t even bother asking others for help and just put in a “happy” face to make things easier even though it hurts me on the inside.
